status_help.up: A newer compatible version is available.
status_help.ok: You already have the latest version.
status_help.manual: Something has to be downloaded by hand: open its page.
status_help.missing: Not on CurseForge or Modrinth (your own mod, or downloaded elsewhere). It is left as is.
status_help.dep: Not in your folder, but another mod needs it to work. It will be installed along with the changes.
note.no_api_download: the author doesn't allow automatic downloads
note.cf_blocked_use_mr: CurseForge doesn't allow the download; using Modrinth
deps.ignored: {parent} lists {dep} as required, but there is no version of {dep} for your Minecraft and mod loader. It's usually the version for another loader: you don't need to do anything.
deps.missing_manual: is missing {name}, which can't be downloaded automatically
beta.allowed_dep: Beta version (you have betas enabled); required by {names}
beta.already: Beta version: you already use this mod's beta
beta.allowed: Beta version: betas are enabled in Settings
beta.installed: You have a beta version installed
row.duplicate: It's duplicated in the folder: keep only one and check again
row.missing_default: Not listed on CurseForge or Modrinth
dl.no_hash: the source gives no hash to verify the download
dl.old_missing: the current jar is no longer in the folder
dl.restored: couldn't place the new jar; the old one was restored: {error}
log.title: Mod update {date}
log.howto:
To revert a mod: delete the new jar from the mods folder and copy the
old jar back from this backup folder. Mods marked [NEW] had no previous
version: just delete them.
err.no_keyring: Can't save the key: Credential Manager is not available
key.rejected: CurseForge doesn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
key.offline: Couldn't connect to CurseForge. Check your internet connection.
setup.err_folder: The folder {path} doesn't exist. Choose your Minecraft mods folder.
setup.err_loader: Choose a mod loader from the list.
scan.err_unknown: Something went wrong during the check ({error}).
notice.no_key: No CurseForge key: only Modrinth was checked, so some mods may show as Not found.
notice.key_rejected: CurseForge doesn't accept your key: only Modrinth was checked. Change it in Settings.
ui.folder_missing: Can't find this folder. Choose your Minecraft mods folder.
ui.folder_empty: The folder exists but has no .jar files.
ui.env_unknown: Couldn't work it out from your mods: check that it's right.
ui.key_in_use_windows: In use: key saved in Windows {hint}
ui.key_none: No key: only Modrinth will be checked
ui.key_placeholder_change: Paste another key to change it
ui.key_storage: It's stored in Windows Credential Manager, not in a file. It's never shown in full.
ui.allow_beta: Suggest beta versions even if you have the stable one
ui.backups_help: Each update keeps the old files. Older backups are deleted.
ui.no_key_note: Only Modrinth will be checked: some mods may show as Not found.
ui.setup_deck: Tell us where they are and, if you like, your CurseForge key. Nothing changes until you confirm.
ui.settings_deck: Changes apply on the next check.
ui.scan_deck: This doesn't change anything in your folder.
ui.step_read: Read the mods in the folder
ui.safe: A copy of your mods is saved before anything changes. You'll be able to undo it at the end.
cli.help_allow_beta: suggest betas even if the current one is stable
cli.help_only: filter by name, comma-separated list (e.g. create,jei)
cli.help_lang: language: auto (from Windows), es or en
cli.no_key: No CF_API_KEY in .env: only Modrinth will be checked.
cli.skipped_duplicate: Skipping {name}: the same mod is duplicated in the folder.
cli.dry_run: Check mode: no files were changed. Use --apply to update.
cli.broken: Your folder already has a problem: {name}: {reason}
cli.minecraft_open: Minecraft is open with this folder (process {pids}). Close it and try again. Nothing was changed.
cli.backup_where: Old jars will be moved (not deleted) to [bold]{path}[/].
cli.pruned_one: 1 old backup was deleted (keeping the last {keep}).
cli.pruned_other: {count} old backups were deleted (keeping the last {keep}).
apply.no_scan: Check your mods again before updating.
apply.minecraft_open: Minecraft is open with this folder. Close it and press the button again.
apply.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
undo.no_log: The change log for this update can't be found.
undo.old_missing: {name}: its previous file is missing from the backup, so it couldn't be restored.
undo.conflict: {name}: there is already a file named {file} in the mods folder; it was left alone.
undo.none: There is no update to undo.
undo.minecraft_open: Minecraft is open with this folder. Close it to undo.
undo.done_one: Done: 1 mod is back to its previous version ({removed} new files set aside in the backup).
undo.done_other: Done: {count} mods are back to their previous version ({removed} new files set aside in the backup).
log.undone: [UNDONE] Update undone on {date}. The new jars are in the undo subfolder.
ui.apply_deck: Don't close the window. If a mod fails, it stays as it was.
ui.done_restart: Open Minecraft to use the new versions.
ui.done_failed_one: 1 change couldn't be applied. That mod is unchanged:
ui.done_failed_other: {count} changes couldn't be applied. Those mods are unchanged:
ui.undo_last_none: There is no update to undo.
row.newer_beta: A newer beta is available ({version}). To have it suggested, enable betas in Settings.
status_help.unreadable: This file couldn't be opened. It's left as is.
err.network: couldn't connect to the download server
err.in_use: the file is in use or not accessible (is Minecraft or another program using it?)
dl.move_old_failed: couldn't set the old jar aside: {error}
row.cf_gone: No longer on CurseForge or Modrinth: newer versions can't be checked
deps.incompatible: {name} {version} declares it's incompatible with {other}, which you have installed. The game may not start.
key.store_failed: The key couldn't be saved in Windows Credential Manager. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart your PC.
key.delete_failed: The key couldn't be deleted from Windows Credential Manager.
scan.err_network: CurseForge and Modrinth aren't responding. Try again in a few minutes.
scan.err_offline: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
net.retry_offline: No response from {source}. Retrying in {seconds} s…
net.retry_busy: {source} asks to wait (too many requests). Retrying in {seconds} s…
net.retry_error: {source} isn't responding properly. Retrying in {seconds} s…
notice.cf_down: CurseForge isn't responding: these results are from Modrinth only. Check again later.
notice.mr_down: Modrinth isn't responding: these results are from CurseForge only. Check again later.
notice.deps_unchecked: Dependencies couldn't be checked (the server didn't respond).
close.title: An update is in progress
close.message: If you close now, the update will be left half-done. You'll be able to undo it from Settings. Close anyway?
app.no_webview2:
Mod Updater needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 component, which isn't installed on this PC.

Open Microsoft's download page?
app.start_failed: The Mod Updater window couldn't be opened ({error}). Check that Microsoft Edge WebView2 is installed.
cli.ap_help: show this help message and exit
ui.list_empty: There are no .jar files in this folder.
ui.deck_empty: Check in Settings that this is your Minecraft mods folder.
cli.ap_one_required: one of the arguments %s is required
cli.interrupted: Warning: the update from {date} was interrupted halfway. To put the folder back as it was, open the app and press Restore, or recover the files from {path}.
recover.title: The last update was interrupted
recover.deck_one: The program closed while updating ({date}) and 1 mod may have been left halfway. Restore puts your mods folder back as it was before that update.
recover.deck_other: The program closed while updating ({date}) and {count} mods may have been left halfway. Restore puts your mods folder back as it was before that update.
